definition: The full metalcraft data chain: raw material (dim_material) → cost fact → product → experience session / auction. Money (TWD), time (session & auction windows), and region (TW-TPE/TW-NTP) facets attach at each hop.
A unique, non-reproducible piece (stock = 1) sold via timed auction with reserve price and minimum increment.
Minimum acceptable price for an auction lot; premium metrics are computed against reserve, not starting price.
92.5% silver alloy; the primary raw material for rings and bracelets. Cost is quoted per gram and linked to the silver spot price.
Bench-time rental of forging stations by half-day slot; a service product type alongside experience courses.
